source_rules.write_syntax: Omitted-file WRITE accepts a comma-separated list of expressions with optional INTEGER literal format specifiers, or CR items.
source_rules.integer: Decimal output has a leading blank; width is a minimum field. The second specifier selects base 2..16; nondecimal width uses leading zeros.
source_rules.real: Default scientific output, minimum field widths and signed fractional precision selecting fixed/scientific forms.
source_rules.cr: Subsequent data starts on the next line.

implementation_choices.evaluation: Render each scalar once, left to right. Validate combined length after all item expressions. Send one completed outer statement to the recorder/callback.
implementation_choices.newline: LF, without automatic separators or a trailing newline unless requested.
implementation_choices.real: Finite Python floats; default .5E, nonnegative precision .nf, negative precision .nE; Python rounding.
implementation_choices.integer: Checked expression range and narrow storage; uppercase digits and minus signs for negative nondecimal values, without inferring controller two's-complement formatting.
implementation_choices.boolean: Existing leading-blank TRUE/FALSE with optional minimum width; no second specifier.
implementation_choices.resource_limits: Combined ASCII output <=254 characters; <=1024 items; numeric/BOOLEAN widths 0..254; REAL precision -254..254. The item/format bounds are prototype guards.
implementation_choices.errors: No outer request on render/length failure. Preserve prior expression effects and nested requests. Callback failures/interruption retain a complete request and unwind routine frames without retry.

retained_boundaries: Initialized known scalar values and existing ownership/type checks
Existing STRING width/alignment and fitting quoted-content guards
No aggregate output, dynamic format expressions, explicit files/devices, binary transfer, READ or IO_STATUS
No native compiler or controller I/O equivalence claim; strict mode remains a future milestone
